title: Ballistic Ventures Seeks $490M for New Funds
excerpt: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is raising $490 million across two separate investment vehicles during an AI-driven cybersecurity boom.
body_html:
Cybersecurity-focused firm Ballistic Ventures is working to raise a total of $490 million for new investment funds. The fundraising effort includes $360 million targeted for a new flagship fund and an additional $130 million allocated for a separate investment vehicle.

This financial push comes amid a broader cybersecurity boom driven by advancements in artificial intelligence. The firm, co-founded by Ted Schlein, focuses specifically on investments within the cybersecurity sector.
